description: This file provides a utility for inspecting and printing the contents of pickle files, including support for zip archives and glob patterns. It defines classes for fake objects and a custom unpickler to handle TorchScript-specific pickling scenarios.

classes.name: FakeObject
classes.description: A mock object representing a pickled object, with custom representation and state handling.

classes.name: FakeClass
classes.description: A factory class to generate FakeObject instances, mimicking classes during unpickling.

classes.name: DumpUnpickler
classes.description: A custom unpickler extending pickle._Unpickler to handle TorchScript-specific pickling, including custom string decoding.

methods.name: FakeObject.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a FakeObject with module, name, and args.

methods.name: FakeObject.__repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the FakeObject.

methods.name: FakeObject.__setstate__
methods.description: Sets the internal state of the FakeObject.

methods.name: FakeClass.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a FakeClass with module and name.

methods.name: FakeClass.__repr__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the FakeClass.

methods.name: FakeClass.__call__
methods.description: Creates a FakeObject instance with given args.

methods.name: FakeClass.fake_new
methods.description: Creates a FakeObject, skipping the first argument.

methods.name: DumpUnpickler.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the custom unpickler with optional UTF-8 error catching.

methods.name: DumpUnpickler.find_class
methods.description: Overrides class finding to return FakeClass instances.

methods.name: DumpUnpickler.persistent_load
methods.description: Creates a FakeObject for persistent IDs.

methods.name: DumpUnpickler.load_binunicode
methods.description: Loads a unicode string, handling invalid UTF-8 if configured.

methods.name: DumpUnpickler.dump
methods.description: Serializes a loaded value to an output stream.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to load and display pickle files or zip archive members based on command-line arguments.
